text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry. I wasn't able to secure the 
victory...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"I managed to do reasonably well—but it 
was just a decent effort. I couldn't land 
a decisive blow."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Yes. What determines the quality of your 
work is whether you can strike right at 
the core.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
If you can nail that down, you'll get good 
results even if you're a bit rough around 
the edges. Conversely—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
If you cannot do that, then no matter how 
carefully you run, you will never be able 
to win.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"It seems my grasp of the race's overall 
picture... was a bit naive."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, I'd like to believe so. No—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"In the end, I'm the one who has to do it. 
I look forward to your guidance."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I cannot deny that somewhere in my 
heart, I had the complacency of thinking, 
"This should be good enough."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"I'd like to ask myself once more. What it 
truly means to 'want to win.'"
